reviewed_by: Claude review of the always-loaded tools selector
reason: ScopePolicy gains always_loaded_tools: a normalized, deduplicated list of runtime tool names that tool_catalog.deferrable_specs() now subtracts from the deferred catalog, so chat.py sends those schemas in the function list instead of hiding them behind tool_catalog.search. api.py accepts the field on the scope PUT with the same None-keeps-stored contract as tool_suggestions/on_demand_tools, and adds GET engagements/{id}/scope/tool-candidates, which names selectable tools exactly as the runtime does (enabled, probed MCP servers, minus enabled_tools/disabled_tools/DENY-override exclusions). tests/v3/test_tool_catalog.py covers the deferral subtraction, an unknown pin, the prepare path where a pinned tool leaves nothing to defer, the PUT normalization and keep-on-omission, and the candidates endpoint's filtering, sorting and 404. tests/v3/test_domain.py covers the validator's trimming, dedupe, sort and length rejection. tests/v3/test_tool_suggestions.py and test_chat_tool_loop.py hold the Jev and chat-loop consumers of the same deferred catalog; test_api_crud_validation.py and test_scope_import.py hold the other scope-policy API and import contracts. On the interface, ui/src/components/EngagementPolicySettings.tsx adds the Always loaded tools checklist to Project Settings › Scope with a new src/components/AlwaysLoadedTools.test.tsx (pin, unpin, a pin no server offers any more, and the empty state that links to MCP settings); client.test.ts covers the wire mapping and the PUT body; the remaining frontend files are the scope fixtures and the Omit that the new required field touches. Playwright area:tool-suggestions renders this exact panel on desktop, mobile-chromium and mobile-webkit and saves the scope through real Core, and entry:stabilization/desktop plus the narrowest and widest mobile entries re-run the Project Policy overflow audit that the new checklist sits inside.
exclusions: No full suites and no native entries: no Rust or src-tauri file changed. The remaining Playwright areas are excluded because the only rendered surface that changed is the Network scope panel inside Advanced settings › Project Policy, which the /settings landing captures never open, so no screenshot baseline moves; the six stabilization projects not listed repeat the same overflow audit at intermediate viewports already bracketed by desktop, mobile-chromium-small and mobile-webkit-wide. Other Python suites are excluded because the field is additive with a default of [], no storage migration or shared schema changed, and deferrable_specs keeps its old behaviour when nothing is pinned. Frontend suites beyond the scope client, the policy form and its fixtures are excluded because no shared component, route or style outside the new checklist changed; the one CSS line is scoped to .policy-form .always-loaded-tools. tests/v3/test_harness_adapters.py::test_claude_native_capabilities_exclude_project_files_and_shell fails on main for unrelated reasons and is tracked separately.
